name: Wring Out
description: The Pokémon literally squeezes the life out of its target, as life is fading, the squeezing will be harder.

name: Wrap
description: The Pokémon traps its foe with its body or vines, causing some damage.

name: Weather Ball
description: The user creates a ball of energy that will use the climate around it to grow in size and power.

name: Vice Grip
description: The Pokémon traps the foe with its pincers or jaws and applies pressure that will leave a nasty bruise.

name: Techno Blast
description: A laser briefly beams away from the Pokémon, whatever it hits explodes a second later. This move can be modified with the right programming of a computer.

name: Thrash
description: The Pokémon rampages and starts to attack and destroy everything on its path.

name: Tri Attack
description: The user shoots three beams. Each one is charged with a different kind of energy.

name: Trump Card
description: The more exhausted the user is, the stronger this attack will become. When the Pokémon is at the last of its strength this move can be devastating.

name: Uproar
description: The Pokémon shouts and screams and squeaks so hard the noise really hurts the ears. Nobody could get a full night of sleep with all that ruckus.

name: Take Down
description: The Pokémon recklessly grapples the foe to smash it on the ground.

name: Tail Slap
description: The Pokémon slaps the foe's face with its strong tail.

name: Tackle
description: A basic attack that consists on charging at an enemy.

name: Swift
description: The user shoots a star shaped light beam that hits the target at blinding speed.

name: Strength
description: The Pokémon strains its muscles to go beyond their own limits.

name: Stomp
description: The Pokémon steps and stomps the foe, the weight may leave the target squished on the floor.

name: Spit Up
description: After storing power, the Pokémon spits that energy at the foe. The user returns to its original size.

name: Spike Cannon
description: The Pokémon shoots a wave of pointy projectiles at the foe.

name: Skull Bash
description: The Pokémon withdraws to its shell then charges against the foe.

name: Slam
description: The user slams the foe with its tail, vines, etc. to deal a decent amount of damage.

name: Slash
description: Using parts of its body as a blade the Pokémon pierces and tears the foe with a vicious force.

name: Smelling Salts
description: The Pokémon throws some volatile salts onto the foe's face, a paralyzed Pokémon will get a strong smell.

name: Snore
description: After falling asleep the user lets out a powerful snore, disrupting any focus the foe had.

name: Self Destruct
description: The Pokémon makes use of its ability to blow up parts of its own body in an impressive display of power.

name: Secret Power
description: This move absorbs the energy around the user. It may unleash that power in unexpected ways.

name: Revelation Dance
description: The Pokémon performs a dance, the dance's engery influences the type of this move.

name: Rock Climb
description: The user climbes on top of the foe. This may be confusing for the Pokémon.

name: Round
description: The user attacks the foe with a song, if a teammate joins the song the attack will be stronger.

name: Scratch
description: The Pokémon uses its sharp claws to scratch the enemy.

name: Retaliate
description: A powerful attack. It will be even stronger if the user just suffered a great loss.

name: Relic Song
description: The user sings and dances to a melody so beautiful you won't notice you were crying while listening to it.

name: Quick Attack
description: An attack as fast as lightning.

name: Rage
description: The user gets angry and throws a tantrum at the foe. If the attacker keeps on fighting, it will make the user rage even harder.

name: Rapid Spin
description: The Pokémon spins swiftly to strike the foe, anything near will be scattered around.

name: Razor Wind
description: A sharp wind current is unleashed against anyone standing against this Pokémon.

name: Pound
description: A decent hit to smash the foes.

name: Pay Day
description: This move grants good fortune, making it more likely to get more money after each battle.

name: Multi Attack
description: A weird-looking Pokémon charges against its foes, the same attack releases different kinds of energy depending on the disk it is holding.

name: Natural Gift
description: The user throws its berry at the foe, the results can be quite surprising.

name: Nature Power
description: The Pokémon makes use of the terrain and asks nature for aid in battle.

name: Mega Punch
description: The Pokémon throws a mega potent hook towards the foe's face.

name: Mega Kick
description: The Pokémon throws a mega powered kick to the foe's face.

name: Last Resort
description: When everything else fails, the Pokémon gives everything in a last resort attack.

name: Hyper Voice
description: The user emits a horrible echoing sound that could burst the ears.

name: Hyper Fang
description: The Pokémon bites hardly into the foe with its powerful fangs.

name: Hyper Beam
description: The Pokémon casts an incredible beam that leaves a giant trail of destruction behind. The user is left exhausted.

name: Horn Attack
description: The Pokémon attacks the foe with its horns, this strike is very painful.

name: Head Charge
description: The Pokémon clashes against the foe using its head as a boulder.

name: Headbutt
description: The user strikes the foe with its hard head. Perfect for taking down fruits from trees or shake Pokémon out of their nests on treetops.

name: Giga Impact
description: The Pokémon strikes with a brutal force using all its body. The impact leaves the user somewhat stunned.

name: Fury Swipes
description: The user swiftly uses its claws to strike the foe multiple times.

name: Fury Attack
description: The Pokémon goes at it with everything its got in a rather disordered way.

name: Extreme Speed
description: The user charges at a blinding speed against the target.

name: Facade
description: The Pokémon will make an upfront attack, if the user is suffering the attack will be stronger.

name: Fake Out
description: While still preparing for battle, the user will suddenly attack the foe.

name: False Swipe
description: The user strikes the foe but lowers the power of the blow at the last second.

name: Feint
description: The Pokémon feints a strike, then hits for real even if the foe attempts to protect itself.

name: Flail
description: The user flails and struggles to survive, the more weakened it is the stronger this attack will be.

name: Explosion
description: The user focuses on exploding its body, the explosion deals a massive wave of damage. A very dangerous move.

name: Egg Bomb
description: The user throws a big egg with great force against its foe.

name: Echoed Voice
description: The user shouts loudly and the echo answers back, it will yell louder every time the echo talks back.

name: Double Edge
description: The user recklessly slams its foe to deal a lot of damage, but it may also hurt itself in the process.

name: Crush Grip
description: The Pokémon grips the foe and starts crushing it. Small targets are difficult to grasp but larger bodies will not be released until they break.

name: Cut
description: A slim but precise cut that may slice through anything.

name: Dizzy Punch
description: A swift punch to the jaw that spins the target and may leave it quite dizzy and disoriented.

name: Double Hit
description: The Pokémon uses the classic "One-Two" to attack the foe.

name: Double Slap
description: The user attacks its foe with two or more slaps in the face.

name: Crush Claw
description: The user crushes its claws against the foe, it may pierce the skin of the foe.

name: Covet
description: The user approaches with caution, deals a quick strike and takes the chance to steal the target's item.

name: Constrict
description: The Pokémon uses its body to hold and constrict the foe. It won't let go easily.

name: Bind
description: The Pokémon uses its body to bind the foe, restraining and squeezing it.

name: Body Slam
description: The user charges against the foe using its body to knock it down, leaving the target stunned.

name: Boomburst
description: The user creates an explosive sound that deafens everyone in the battlefield.

name: Chip Away
description: The user looks for an opening and strikes directly there. It nibbles bit by bit even the toughest of surfaces.

name: Comet Punch
description: The user throws a quick series of punches at the foe.

name: Barrage
description: The Pokémon throws many round objects at the target, one after the other.

name: Veevee Volley
description: Long sessions playing volley ball with your Pokémon make it very happy. During battle, it just replaces the ball with its foe.

name: Super Fang
description: The Pokémon jumps at the foe to crush it with an awful bite.

name: Sonic Boom
description: The Pokémon attacks with a small destructive shock that can go through armor, thick hide or walls to deal some damage.

name: Metronome
description: The Pokémon waves its hands with rhythm. The energy around follows the cadence and manifests with an impressive attack.

name: Return
description: If the Pokémon is treated with care and love, it will return that affection by giving all its got in battle.

name: Present
description: The user approaches its foe and gives it a lovely present that may be nice or may be a prank.

name: Me First
description: The user anticipates the next attack so it can hit the target with an astounding speed.

name: Judgment
description: Eventually, everyone gets what they deserve.

name: Horn Drill
description: The user stabs the target with a horn used like a drill, the foe is often left in a critical condition. A move to be wary of.

name: Hidden Power
description: Every Pokémon has an unknown power that can be released with surprising results.

name: Frustration
description: A move that relies on how badly a Pokémon has been treated to make it vicious and uncaring.

name: Guillotine
description: The Pokémon uses the sharpest part of its body to almost snap the neck of its foe. It is a devastating attack. The foe must be lucky to get out of it alive.

name: Endeavor
description: With pure willpower, the user struggles with its foe despite the pain.

name: Bide
description: The user endures the hit then unleashes an attack even greater.

name: Yawn
description: The user lets out an infectious yawn that will make anyone drowzy enough to fall asleep pretty soon.

name: Work Up
description: The Pokémon exercises with vigor to be physically and mentally prepared for battle.

name: Wish
description: The Pokémon makes a wish with all its might and somehow it becomes true.

name: Whirlwind
description: The Pokémon creates a powerful wind current that swirls the enemy around and sends it flying away.

name: Transform
description: The user modifies its own DNA structure to become an identical clone of any Pokémon or object it can see.

name: Tickle
description: The Pokémon tickles the foe. The laughter really disturbs the foe's fighting stance.

name: Teeter Dance
description: The user starts dancing around with woobly movements. Friends and foes will get dizzy by trying to follow it.

name: Teatime
description: The Pokémon gathers everyone for a cup of delicious tea, not eating a snack along with it would be a waste.

name: Tearful Look
description: The Pokémon's eyes start watering as if it were about to cry, its foe is moved by the tears and loses its will to fight.

name: Tail Whip
description: The Pokémon moves its tail in such a cute way that the foe will easily let its guard down.

name: Swords Dance
description: The Pokémon makes a dance that raises its battle spirit.

name: Sweet Scent
description: The Pokémon releases an aroma that its enemies will love.

name: Swallow
description: The Pokémon swallows the energy it was storing to restore some damage, it recovers its normal size afterwards.

name: Swagger
description: The Pokémon enrages the foe with its arrogant demeanor, making it lose focus in battle.

name: Supersonic
description: The Pokémon emits a series of ultrasonic waves that make the foe dizzy and disoriented.

name: Substitute
description: The Pokémon disappears in a poof of smoke. When the smoke vanishes, an object identical to the user remains in its place to shield it from harm. It looks amazingly real.

name: Stuff Cheeks
description: The Pokémon munches its berry but it keeps part of it in its cheeks. Looks adorable but it is actually a survival tactic to survive harsh winters.

name: Stockpile
description: The Pokémon swells up by storing power with its mouth, this makes the user a little more resistant to damage.

name: Spotlight
description: The user points a focused light onto one of its allies as if it were on a stage, the ally can't help but catch everyone's attention onto itself.

name: Splash
description: The user just flops splashing some water, this has no effect at all...

name: Soft Boiled
description: The user boils a freshly layed egg and restored health with the energy stored within.

name: Smokescreen
description: The user covers its foe with a cloud of smoke. Some Pokémon hide inside this screen while others use it as cover to escape.

name: Sleep Talk
description: After falling asleep, the Pokémon is still dreaming about the fight.

name: Slack Off
description: The Pokémon gets lazy and loafs around instead of fighting. This makes up for a short rest.

name: Sketch
description: The Pokémon draws its foe performing a move, it learns how to perform that move in the process.

name: Sing
description: With a charming song, the user lulls its foe to sleep.

name: Simple Beam
description: The Pokémon sends a small psychic wave to its target, giving it a simpler point of view about the world.

name: Shell Smash
description: By breaking its own shell, the user sacrifices defense in exchange of being free to fight with all its power.

name: Sharpen
description: The user cuts down the rough edges of its body to make it as sharp as a razor.

name: Screech
description: The user disrupts the fighting stance of its foe by sending a sharp sound to the foe's ears.

name: Scary Face
description: By making a frightening face, the Pokémon makes others think twice about coming near.

name: Safeguard
description: The Pokémon creates an energy shield that protects everyone from harm.

name: Roar
description: A mighty roar that scares the foe.

name: Refresh
description: The Pokémon takes a few seconds to cool down and get back in the game.

name: Reflect Type
description: The Pokémon appears to change its own physiology. This effect changes the type of the user to match another Pokémon in sight.

name: Recycle
description: One Pokémon's trash is another one's tresure.

name: Recover
description: The Pokémon's concentrates on restoring its own cells faster than anything imaginable.

name: Psych Up
description: The Pokémon's mentalizes itself stronger than anyone. They feel good. They can win. They. Can. Do. This.

name: Protect
description: The user creates an energy shield to deflect a blow. Some Pokémon may even perform an amazing parry to block the incoming attack.

name: Play Nice
description: The user starts playing with the foe in a friendly way. This makes the foe reconsider its aggressive demeanor.

name: Perish Song
description: A song of mourning and despair that resonates on the minds of anyone who listens. Makes you feel like you are on your death bed.

name: Pain Split
description: The user shares its pain with the foe. After a short while it becomes excruciating for the target.

name: Odor Sleuth
description: The Pokémon uses its keen smell to detect the foe.

name: Noble Roar
description: The Pokémon makes a roar that commands respect and authority over anyone listening.

name: Morning Sun
description: The sun shines brightly on the Pokémon and makes it feel rejuvenated like early in the morning.

name: Minimize
description: The Pokémon compacts its body, appearing smaller than its normal size.

name: Mind Reader
description: The user reads the foe's mind. It knows exactly what to do next.

name: Mimic
description: Making use of its acting talents, the Pokémon imitates what the target just did.

name: Milk Drink
description: The Pokémon drinks a glass of its own milk, the rich taste and nutrients revitalize it.

name: Mean Look
description: The Pokémon gives a menacing look that freezes the foe on the spot with intense fear.

name: Lucky Chant
description: The user chants an incantation to the skies, the beautiful performance grants this Pokémon and its allies divine protection.

name: Lovely Kiss
description: The Pokémon approaches the foe with a skiss. Its ugly face and awful smooch make the poor creature faint in terror.

name: Lock-On
description: The Pokémon's eyes zoom at a moving target to ensure that the next attack will be dealt with precision.

name: Leer
description: A vicious glare that will make any opponent doubt its own strength in battle.

name: Laser Focus
description: Through its incredible awareness the Pokémon finds a straight path into a weak point of the foe. The attack that follows is usually devastating.

name: Howl
description: The Pokémon let's out an impressive howl, making it appear a lot more menacing.

name: Helping Hand
description: The Pokémon assists an ally. Together they are stronger.

name: Heal Bell
description: The Pokémon chimes a magical bell, legend says the soothing sound has healing properties.

name: Harden
description: The user stiffens its body and prepares for any incoming attack.

name: Growth
description: The Pokémon expands its body, it grows bigger and stronger.

name: Growl
description: Either by a mancing attitude or cute demeanor, the foe will be unsure about attacking the user with full force.

name: Glare
description: The Pokémon uses its intimidating glare to paralyze the foe with sheer terror.

name: Foresight
description: The Pokémon uses its developed senses and mental ability to foresee the immediate future.

name: Follow Me
description: The Pokémon will draw everyone's attention. All foes are taunted to do their worst.

name: Focus Energy
description: The Pokémon's energy is raised to make all strikes much more precise.

name: Flash
description: The user suddenly emits a blinding light around its body, dazing its opponent in the process.

name: Entrainment
description: The Pokémon dances with a catchy rhythm. The target starts dancing too and both connect to a very personal level through this performance.

name: Endure
description: The user gets prepared to receive a fatal blow. It resists the pain despite being seriously hurt.

name: Encore
description: The user claps and cheers at the target to encourage it to repeat what it just did.

name: Double Team
description: The user moves rapidly around the foe, creating illusory copies of itself.

name: Disable
description: The user hits a nerve on the foe, impeding it from performing its previous action for a short while.

name: Defense Curl
description: The user curls like a ball to protect against most threats.

name: Court Change
description: The Pokémon signals the referee for half-time, the referee complies and both parties swap their sides of the field. Wait. Did we forget something?

name: Copycat
description: The user will closely watch the movements of the target and will imitate them to perfection.

name: Conversion 2
description: The Pokémon downloads the data of a move that was used against it. Change the code of the user to a type resistant to that move.

name: Conversion
description: The Pokémon downloads the data of a move to add it to its code.

name: Confide
description: The Pokémon tells a secret to the target. The foe loses its ability to concentrate.

name: Captivate
description: The Pokémon shows off its attractiveness and even flirts with the opponents, those who fall for its charms can't focus on the battle.

name: Camouflage
description: The user mimics the environment, it becomes one with the surroundings.

name: Block
description: The user moves swiftly, blocking the escape routes of the foe.

name: Bestow
description: The Pokémon respectfully offers an item, the target will take it and keep it to be polite.

name: Belly Drum
description: The Pokémon roars a war cry while hitting its belly.

name: Baton Pass
description: The user stores part of its power on a twig or a stick, anyone who touches the item will recieve its might.

name: Attract
description: The user makes use of its good looks and attitude to infatuate its foe.

name: Assist
description: The Pokémon hurriedly remembers one action performed by a partner. Some Pokémon can even do what a human does and assist him with any tasks.

name: After You
description: The user bows and courteously lets an ally or foe use their action first.

name: Accupressure
description: The user starts pushing its pressure points, releasing the energy that was stored in its body.

name: Wake-up Slap
description: A powerful slap that makes even the laziest Pokémon be well awake.

name: Vital Throw
description: The Pokémon awaits for the perfect moment to strike the foe.

name: Vacuum Wave
description: The user pulls the enemy closer using the power of its ki. This traction has a lot of strength and may break anything it pulls.

name: Triple Kick
description: The user throws three or more kicks, leaving the harder blow for the end.

name: Superpower
description: The Pokémon makes use of all its force to deliver a crushing strike to the foe, this demands a lot from the user.

name: Submission
description: The user recklessly struggles with the foe to pin it to the ground.

name: Storm Throw
description: The user impacts a weak spot with a powerful blow.

name: Sky Uppercut
description: The user attacks with an uppercut, throwing the foe skyward with lots of force.

name: Quick Guard
description: The user reacts instinctively and defends itself and its teammates, nullifying the effects of the fastest attacks.

name: Revenge
description: The Pokémon fights ruthlessly and may retaliate fiercely against a foe that has hurt the user.

name: Reversal
description: The user gathers its mettle to block away the pain and focus only on hitting harder.

name: Rock Smash
description: A powerful hit that can crush rocks. Used against a foe it is sure to leave an awful bruise and a crack on its armor.

name: Rolling Kick
description: The user spins in the air landing an impressive kick that may daze the target.

name: Sacred Sword
description: The user slashes its target with a mighty blade that no armor can stop.

name: Secret Sword
description: An invisible wave cuts through the target, you can feel its sharp edge but you cannot see it.

name: Seismic Toss
description: The target gets launched up then falls face first into the ground, the stronger the user the higher the foe will be thrown.

name: Power-up Punch
description: The Pokémon uses this punch to test the surface of an object. The user toughens up to deal better blows.

name: Octolock
description: The user wraps its tenctacles to immobilize the foe. Being so close enables the user to find weak spots.

name: No Retreat
description: No surrender. No retreat. Until victory always.

name: Meteor Assault
description: The Pokémon will make an incredible jump to the sky, then lunge towards the foe at a staggering speed, crashing the ground upon impact. The user is left very tired.

name: Mat Block
description: The Pokémon uses a mat or something similar as a shield.

name: Mach Punch
description: The user launches a punch so quickly that it's barely seen.

name: Low Sweep
description: The Pokémon strikes the foe's legs, leaving it unable to walk normally or run.

name: Low Kick
description: The user kicks the target making it fall, the bigger the foe the harder the fall.

name: Flying Press
description: The user flies towards the foe from the sky in pure Lucha Libre style.

name: Focus Blast
description: The user concentrates and releases a blast of energy.

name: Focus Punch
description: A brutal punch that requires calm and concentration.

name: Force Palm
description: A powerful open palm hit that knocks the foe away and may leave him unable to move.

name: Hammer Arm
description: A mighty arm thrust that leaves the user quite tired.

name: High Jump Kick
description: The user launches itself up and falls down with a brutal kick. It might hurt the user if it doesn't hit the target.

name: Jump Kick
description: The Pokémon jumps and delivers a powerful kick. It might hurt the user if it doesn't hit the target.

name: Karate Chop
description: A basic fighting chop that has been practiced and mastered.

name: Final Gambit
description: The Pokémon uses its last strength into an all-or-nothing attack, after that, it faints.

name: Dynamic Punch
description: A punch that hits a small pressure point. It leaves the foe disoriented.

name: Drain Punch
description: The Pokémon strikes with a powerful punch. Through contact, it absorbs some vital energy.

name: Double Kick
description: The user throws two powerful kicks.

name: Detect
description: The user detects the intentions of the attacker and acts out to minimize the damage.

name: Cross Chop
description: The user delivers a chop with its arms crossed trying to hit a weak spot.

name: Counter
description: The user prepares to receive damage, then returns that same damage and more.

name: Close Combat
description: The user attacks at a close distance to deal lots of damage. The foe is also close enough to attack.

name: Arm Thrust
description: The user quickly throws blows of open-palmed thrusts against the foe.

name: Aura Sphere
description: The user channels its aura and launches this power in the form of a sphere. The foe's aura is hit, leaving the target unscratched but deeply hurt.

name: Body Press
description: The Pokémon makes a judo maneuver, using its body mass instead of its strength against the target.

name: Brick Break
description: The Pokémon uses its palm or claws to perform a one-armed chop that shatters even invisible barriers.

name: Bulk Up
description: The Pokémon shows its muscles with intimidating poses to look bigger and stronger.

name: Circle Throw
description: The user throws the target 60 feet out the battlefield.

name: Wing Attack
description: The user flies towards the foe and strikes with its wings.

name: Tailwind
description: User flaps its wings and casts a turbulent wind that helps the team move significantly faster.

name: Sky Drop
description: The user carries the opponent to the sky, then drops the target from that altitude.

name: Sky Attack
description: The Pokémon darts from the sky with a graceful and lethal strike, propelling with the wind, crushing the foe on the ground.

name: Roost
description: The Pokémon uses its action to land on the ground and relax.

name: Pluck
description: The user gives a hard peck and may get something tasty out of the foe.

name: Peck
description: The Pokémon uses its beak or horn to jab the foe, hurting a little bit.

name: Oblivion Wing
description: A dark wind rises, turning everything it touches into dust to be scattered until nothing remains. People, Pokémon, plants, everything fades away like a distant memory.

name: Dragon Ascent
description: The user rises above the clouds and then comes crashing down against its foe in an instant. The strike is brutal for both.

name: Drill Peck
description: The user pierces the foe with its beak used as a drill. A dangerous move.

name: Feather Dance
description: A beautiful dance that soothes the hearts of those who watch it, reducing their aggressive intentions.

name: Floaty Fall
description: With the help of some air balloons, the user jumps up high and falls on top of its foe. The use of balloons in-battle is questionable, but the referee will allow them.

name: Fly
description: The user flies up high in one action, then drops and strikes in the next one. The Pokémon can fly for extremely long periods of time without getting tired.

name: Gust
description: The Pokémon flaps its wings to strike the foe with wind.

name: Hurricane
description: The user attacks by wrapping the opponent in a fierce wind that carries the target up into the sky.

name: Mirror Move
description: The user concentrates and manages to imitate the last move used by the foe.

name: Defog
description: A strong current of wind that blows away any fog and even invisible barriers.

name: Chatter
description: The user starts talking and giving orders in human language. It may be extremely confusing for the foes.

name: Brave Bird
description: The Pokémon flies straight at the foe at full speed, the collision might hurt both of them.

name: Bounce
description: The Pokémon will jump 30 feet in the air before landing on top of the foe. The user won't suffer any falling dammage.

name: Beak Blast
description: The Pokémon gets ready to release a boiling gas through its beak, which gets incredibly hot. The resulting blast sounds like a train's horn.

name: Air Slash
description: The user will surround the foe with razor-like wind that may knock it down.

name: Air Cutter
description: The user will send out a wave of sharp wind that will harm anything it touches.

name: Aeroblast
description: The victim is trapped in a violently swirling vortex. The strong wind currents make debris fly everywhere.

name: Acrobatics
description: The user makes quick and graceful acrobatic moves to hit the foe, it will be swifter if nothing gets in the way.

name: Aerial Ace
description: The Pokémon rises up in the air towards a light source, momentarily blinding the foe, then plummets quickly to attack the opponent.

name: Venoshock
description: The Pokémon shoots a special kind of toxin that reacts violently if the foe is already weakened with poison.

name: Venom Drench
description: Foes are drenched in an odd poisonous liquid that targets their weakened immune systems.

name: Toxic Thread
description: The user shoots a sticky thread that entagles around the foe, the thread is also laced with a potent toxin that will poison the foe on contact.

name: Toxic Spikes
description: The user lays a trap of scattered poison spikes that attach to the opponent's feet leaving them with a bad case of fever.

name: Toxic
description: With a disgusting diet and training, the user learns how to turn its fluids into a deadly toxin.

name: Smog
description: The target is attacked with a discharge of filthy gases.

name: Sludge Wave
description: The Pokémon creates a large wave of watery ooze that soaks everything around. The smell is really unpleasant.

name: Sludge Bomb
description: The user hurls a ball of toxic sludge that explodes on contact and covers the target.

name: Sludge
description: The foe is covered with a disgusting sludge, the fumes and toxins on it can make anyone feel sick.

name: Purify
description: The Pokémon is covered by a gelatinous goo that can be used to treat several ailments, the Pokémon also uses it as a source of nourishment.

name: Poison Tail
description: The tail of this Pokémon is sharp like a blade, it attacks with slashing movements and may release some poison through it.

name: Poison Sting
description: The user shoots a small sting that injects venom into the foe.

name: Poison Powder
description: The user scatters a small cloud of venomous dust that immediately causes coughing and fever.

name: Poison Jab
description: The Pokémon stabs its foe with a sting or tentacle drenched with venom.

name: Poison Gas
description: The Pokémon releases a big cloud of toxic gas, anyone who takes a breath will start coughing violently. They should seek a doctor immediately.

name: Poison Fang
description: The Pokémon bites the foe and injects its poison directly through its fangs. After that it just waits for the poison to slowly take care of its foe.

name: Gunk Shot
description: The Pokémon shoots a stream of corrosive sludge made with the most toxic substances it can produce. Just inhaling the scent can make you feel very sick.

name: Gastro Acid
description: The user spits some of its own gastric juices, the acid prevents the foe from using its special abilities.

name: Cross Poison
description: The Pokémon drenches poison into its pincers to slash the enemy in a brutal way.

name: Coil
description: The Pokémon curls up its body. In a calm but menacing position it prepares to deliver its strike.

name: Clear Smog
description: The user sucks all gases to clear away all impurities. The target is left feeling hurt, but light headed.

name: Belch
description: The user lets out a horrible belch on the target. The air contains toxins that deal terrible damage.

name: Baneful Bunker
description: The user encloses itself inside its sturdy shell, which is covered by poisonous barbs, if a barb punches the foe's skin the wound will start to fester.

name: Acid Spray
description: The user spits a corrosive substance, the burning sensation doesn't allow it to focus on attacking.

name: Acid Armor
description: A liquid acid substance seeps through this Pokeémon's body turning it into a liquid-like state. The acid deters foes from touching this Pokémon at full force.

name: Acid
description: The Pokémon showers its foes with a corrosive acid, the burning sensation may leave an opening for other attacks.

name: Bone Club
description: The user hits the target with a bone, the smack may leave a bump on the target's head.

name: Bone Rush
description: The user quickly strikes the foe with a bone, one blow after another.

name: Bonemerang
description: The Pokémon throws a bone to hit the foe. The bone returns like a boomerang, striking a second time.

name: Bulldoze
description: The user stomps and tramples the place, breaking stones, trees and everything nearby.

name: Dig
description: The user digs a tunnel on the ground and attacks while coming out from below.

name: Drill Run
description: The user rotates its body imitating a drill and crashes against the foe. This attack may pierce through walls and floors with ease and great precision.

name: Earth Power
description: The user sends out a subterranean wave that bursts on the ground bellow the target. It looks like the earth molds to the Pokémon's will.

name: Earthquake
description: The Pokémon focuses its energy into shaking the ground, everyone around will be thrown like a rag doll.

name: Fissure
description: The user tears the ground apart in a monstrous display of force, if the foe falls through the fissure it might need a rescue team to get it out.

name: High Horsepower
description: The Pokémon rushes towards its target and tramples it without mercy.

name: Land's Wrath
description: The earth moves on its own, no attacker in sight. The floor crumbles and the ground shakes engulfing its victims. From the rubble, lush trees emerge a short time after.

name: Magnitude
description: The user quakes the ground plates. Some plates will move easier than others.

name: Mud Bomb
description: The Pokémon shoots a ball made of mud that bursts on the target, some mud may get on its eyes.

name: Mud Shot
description: The Pokémon shoots stream of mud that covers the foe, obstructing its movement.

name: Mud Slap
description: The user hurls some mud to the face of the foe, leaving it unable to see clearly.

name: Mud Sport
description: The user covers everything with mud, reducing the effectiveness of electric attacks made on the field.

name: Precipice Blades
description: Giant blades emerge from the earth with every step of the user. If you fall into them, they are almost impossible to survive.

name: Rototiller
description: The Pokémon digs around and moves the soil to make it ideal for plant growth.

name: Sand Attack
description: The user shoots some sand into the opponent's eyes.

name: Sand Tomb
description: The Pokémon creates a shifting sand pit around the foe, leaving it unable to escape.

name: Shore Up
description: The Pokémon gathers the sand around itself to restore its body to shape.

name: Spikes
description: The Pokémon shoots pointy pebbles or thorns around the field that deal damage to anyone coming from that side.

name: Stomping Tantrum
description: The Pokémon throws a tantrum all over the place, it becomes worse if something has frustrated it earlier.

name: Thousand Arrows
description: Out of nowhere, pointy shards come raining from the sky towards the foes, even flying creatures will fall to the ground if they are knocked by them. Take cover, this is gonna hurt.

name: Thousand Waves
description: Solid ground becomes a sandtrap, cracked earth will close to ensnare your feet. It's as if the land itself wanted to trap you. There is no attacker nor escape in sight.

name: Accelerock
description: The Pokémon dashes at great speed using the rocks on its body to strike its foe upon impact.

name: Ancient Power
description: The Pokémon calls upon an energy from ancient times that strikes the foe and may infuse the user with a primal strength.

name: Diamond Storm
description: The Pokémon summons a storm of diamonds over the field, these diamonds also serve as barriers the user can take cover into.

name: Head Smash
description: The user charges head first to attack the foe, the strike is devastating for both.

name: Power Gem
description: The user attacks with a ray of light that comes out of the gem on its body.

name: Rock Blast
description: The Pokémon shoots and throws small rock pebbles that burst into tiny pieces as they touch the foe.

name: Rock Polish
description: The user polishes the rough ends of its rock body for easier and faster movement.

name: Rock Slide
description: The Pokémon creates a slide of falling rocks against its foes that may leave them crushed below the rubble.

name: Rock Throw
description: The user picks up a rock or pebble and throws it at the foe.

name: Rock Tomb
description: The Pokémon covers the foe in gravel and rocks, leaving it unable to move freely.

name: Rock Wrecker
description: The user shoots a huge boulder as if it were a cannon ball that can even go through thick walls. This, however, requires a lot of energy from the user.

name: Rollout
description: The user curls up into a ball and starts rolling towards its foe, trampling everything in its way.

name: Sandstorm
description: The Pokémon casts a fierce wind that carries millions of rough sand particles.

name: Smack Down
description: The user hurls a projectile, usually a heavy rock that sends the foe down to the ground, leaving it unable to take off the ground afterwards.

name: Stealth Rock
description: The Pokémon hides sharp and pointy rocks all over the foe's side of the battlefield.

name: Stone Edge
description: The user hurles sharp stones at the foe. The speed and weight of the stones deals a severe amount of damage.

name: Tar Shot
description: The Pokémon gushes a blob of black tar over its foe. The unfortunate victim can barely move afterwards, keep it away from fire sources, tar is extremely flammable.

name: Wide Guard
description: The Pokémon uses its whole body to provide coverage and protection to its allies against an incoming attack.

name: Attack Order
description: The user calls upon her swarm and heeds them to charge against you. No matter where you run, they will surround you. Hope you are not allergic to bees.

name: Bug Bite
description: The Pokémon nibbles its foe, if it finds something tasty it will eat it in an instant. It may try to eat almost anything.

name: Bug Buzz
description: The Pokémon uses its wings or a part of its body to emit sound waves that harm and affect the target.

name: Defend Order
description: A swarm of bugs flies around the user, creating a barrier to protect this Pokémon from damage.

name: Fell Stinger
description: The Pokémon stings the target, if the foe is too weakened to move it absorb part of its power.

name: First Impression
description: The Pokémon makes a dramatic entrance to the battlefield, taking the foe by surprise as to who its opponent really is.

name: Fury Cutter
description: The Pokémon makes use of its claws or scythes to land as many hits as possible.

name: Heal Order
description: The Pokémon commands its swarm to bring some healing honey.

name: Infestation
description: The Pokémon summons a huge swarm of bugs to prevent the foe from escaping. Sometimes the swarm may take a hit to the foe. The call extends for hundreds of yards.

name: Leech Life
description: The user attacks a vital spot and sucks away the vitality of its foe.

name: Tail Glow
description: The user emits a strong light. This Pokémon will stare at its brightness to enter a trance.

name: Twineedle
description: The Pokémon stabs the foe with its stinger, claws or spikes infused with poison.

name: U-Turn
description: The user strikes its foe, then quickly goes back to safety while another party Pokémon takes its place.

name: X-Scissor
description: The Pokémon uses its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors to cut through the foe.

name: Quiver Dance
description: A mystical and beautiful dance that boosts a Pokémon's dexterity and focus.

name: Powder
description: The foe is fully covered with a flammable powder, a source of fire might ignite it with explosive results.

name: Pollen Puff
description: The Pokémon creates a puff of pollen that explodes on the foe's face and gives them a terrible allergy. When consumed these puffs are sweet and very nutritious.

name: Pin Missile
description: The Pokémon showers its foe with stings or spikes that pierce like needles.

name: Megahorn
description: The Pokémon uses its strong horn[s] to pierce its foe and deal massive damage.

name: Lunge
description: The user charges against the foe at full force, not just to knock it down but to restrain it with its many limbs.

name: Rage Powder
description: The Pokémon releases an irritating powder that annoys and enrages foes into attacking.

name: Signal Beam
description: The user emits an intense light that harms the foes and may leave them dazed like moths.

name: Silver Wind
description: The Pokémon blows a beautiful silver colored wind that harms the foe, the performance may give the user a big confidence boost.

name: Spider Web
description: The user quietly releases a web on the field. All foes will be trapped.

name: Steamroller
description: The user curls up and rolls at full speed to strike the foe. It may leave the target swatted on the ground.

name: Sticky Web
description: The Pokémon quickly covers the arena with a sticky web, newly arrived foes will have trouble moving with ease.

name: String Shot
description: The user shoots a silk string that ties and limits the movement of its foe.

name: Struggle Bug
description: The Pokémon lays on its back and struggles with the foe, disrupting the foe's concentration.

name: Astonish
description: The user sneaks close and startles the foe.

name: Confuse Ray
description: The user flashes a sinister ray of bright light that leaves the target disoriented and confused.

name: Curse
description: The user mutters words that become an evil incantation, the curse may only be lifted by a medium or through divine intervention.

name: Curse
description: The Pokémon prepares to deal and receive damage by muttering something not appropriate for kids.

name: Destiny Bond
description: The Pokémon creates a mystical bond with anyone that causes it harm. Whatever ill falls on the user, it will fall on the perpetrator too.

name: Grudge
description: The user leaves an imprinting grudge over the foe, this makes the target unwilling to fight. It may only keep battling if something greater is at risk.

name: Hex
description: The user casts a terrible hex over the target, the effects will be greater if the target is vulnerable.

name: Shadow Bone
description: The bone that this Pokémon uses as a weapon contains a spirit, that spirit may cling onto a victim, creating openings for its master.

name: Shadow Ball
description: The Pokémon hurls a sphere made of shadow and dark matter to harm the foe.

name: Phantom Force
description: The Pokémon disappears into a dark dimension to infiltrate even the most impenetrable defenses. It may reappear during its next action.

name: Ominous Wind
description: The Pokémon sends out a goosebump-inducing, repulsive wind that might make the user feel an evil rush.

name: Nightmare
description: The user enters the target's dreams to torment it.

name: Night Shade
description: The user casts a shade with a frightening mirage inside that torments the target.

name: Moongeist Beam
description: A cold reflection of the moon shines upon the target, it doesn't hurt physically but those who stare directly into the light simply collapse.

name: Lick
description: The user licks the foe. The saliva can numb the body of most creatures.

name: Shadow Claw
description: Claws become semi-ethereal and are able to briefly pierce armor, hide, skin and objects so it can strike the target on any weak spot.

name: Shadow Force
description: The Pokémon disappears into a dark dimension to strike its foe at the next oppurtunity. The blow will hurt the target not on their body but directly into their soul.

name: Shadow Punch
description: The Pokémon punches through its own shadow. The attack comes out from the foe's shadows as if it were a portal.

name: Shadow Sneak
description: The user sneaks through darkness and strikes out of the target's shadow. The Pokémon can move freely inside shades as if it were incorporeal.

name: Spectral Thief
description: Through the shadows, the user sneaks on its target to steal its life force and consume it, leaving the victim with a sense of grief and loss.

name: Spirit Shackle
description: While attacking, the user sneakily binds its foe's shadow to the ground, restricting its movement and making it unable to escape.

name: Spite
description: The target feels overwhelmed by feelings of dread.

name: Trick-or-Treat
description: The Pokémon takes the target Trick-or-Treating. The target gets a ghost costume which somehow cannot be removed without a medium's help.

name: Anchor Shot
description: The Pokémon hurls an anchor towards its foe and entangles it with seaweed, the anchor drags the foe down so it cannot escape.

name: Autotomize
description: The Pokémon sheds pieces and starts rotating other parts of its body for easier and lighter movement.

name: Behemoth Bash
description: The Pokémon becomes a giant energy shield that tramples everything on its wake. If the foe is under the effects of the Dynamax phenomenon all its energy will be swept away.

name: Behemoth Blade
description: The Pokémon becomes a giant sword with a razor-sharp blade. If the foe is under the effects of the Dynamax phenomenon all its energy will be slashed to bits.

name: Bullet Punch
description: The user launches itself against the foe to strike it with an iron fist.

name: Doom Desire
description: Be careful what you wish for, this Pokémon will read your most intimate wishes and make them come true in very twisted ways.

name: Double Iron Bash
description: The user hardens its limbs and then rotates them at great speed to hit the foe twice in a row. The blow can leave the victim crushed in the floor.

name: Flash Cannon
description: The Pokémon absorbs the reflecting light on its body and releases a powerful beam against the foe.

name: Gear Grind
description: The user traps the foe between its gears and crushes it with two painful grinds.

name: Gear Up
description: The user engages its gears on an ally to leave the ally's body working like a well-oiled machine.

name: Gyro Ball
description: The user curls up in a ball and spins against the target at a high speed.

name: Heavy Slam
description: The user slams the foe using its whole body weight. Smaller foes will be deeply affected.

name: Iron Defense
description: The Pokémon hardens its body surface as if it was made from the strongest iron around.

name: Iron Head
description: The Pokémon charges at the foe with a brutal headbutt that may leave the target knocked down on the ground.

name: Iron Tail
description: The user hits the foe with its hardened tail. The target is left vulnerable against subsequent attacks.

name: King's Shield
description: The Pokémon uses a ghostly shield to protect itself. If the foe managed to touch it, the user will drain some of its lifeforce.

name: Magnet Bomb
description: The Pokémon hurls a metal bomb that is attracted to the target like a magnet. The moment it touches the foe, it will explode.

name: Metal Burst
description: After receiving damage, the user bursts the tiny but sharp metal pieces that came loose because of the foe's attack. The greater the impact the more metal it will shoot.

name: Metal Claw
description: The Pokémon attacks using its sharp claws, the friction may leave them even sharper.

name: Metal Sound
description: The user produces a horrible noise that impedes the foe from focusing on the fight, leaving it vulnerable to attacks.

name: Meteor Mash
description: The user charges with a strong fist and strikes like a meteor.

name: Mirror Shot
description: The user dazes the foe with a beam of light. Those who have experienced it describe it as, "being in a mirror labyrinth."

name: Shift Gear
description: The Pokémon has its gears rotate quickly. Working like a powerful machine.

name: Smart Strike
description: The user stabs the foe using one of its sharp horns with astounding precision, the resulting wound will be very deep and must be treated immediately.

name: Steel Beam
description: A concentrated ray of light that's capable of melting even the thickest steel plates. Unfortunately the user will also have trouble handling this power.

name: Steel Wing
description: The Pokémon uses its sharp feathers as if they were razors.

name: Sunsteel Strike
description: You suddenly stop in your tracks as you see a bright and blinding light coming towards you at great speed. You did not see what hit you and then it's all darkness.

name: Blast Burn
description: The Pokémon uses all of its power to deliver an infernal blast to the foe. The user is left exhausted.

name: Blaze Kick
description: The user throws a mighty kick engulfed in fire that may leave a bad looking burn.

name: Blue Flare
description: The user surrounds itself with giant blue flame that is unleashed with an earth shattering explosion. Receiving this attack directly might completely engulf you in fire.

name: Burn Up
description: The user unleashes all of its might through a massive blast of raging fire. Although the damage is devastating the Pokémon is left unable to produce more fire for at least a day.

name: Fire Punch
description: The user can ignite its fists for a brief moment without any danger of getting burned. The foe may not be so lucky.

name: Fire Pledge
description: The Pokémon chants to invoke the power of fire. Its pledge is heard, then the flames consume everything around.

name: Fire Lash
description: With a whip of fire, the Pokémon ensnares its foe, who is left defenseless and at its mercy.

name: Fire Fang
description: The user breathes fire from its mouth while biting the target.

name: Fire Blast
description: The Pokémon shoots a giant fireball that explodes on contact with the foe, blasting fire in all directions.

name: Fiery Dance
description: The user cloaks itself in flames and shoots them while dancing gracefully.

name: Eruption
description: A fierce burst of lava coming from the user at full force charring whatever comes in contact with it.

name: Ember
description: The user shoots a small flame against the target that may cause a first-degree burn.

name: Fire Spin
description: The user creates a vortex of fire that remains spinning in the battlefield, trapping the foe within.

name: Flame Burst
description: A concentrated flameball that bursts on contact with the foe, scattering smaller flames around.

name: Flame Charge
description: The Pokémon uses its flames as propulsion to strike the foe.

name: Flame Wheel
description: The user cloaks itself in flames and rolls to tackle the target.

name: Flamethrower
description: The user lets out a powerful fire stream that leaves a scorched trail.

name: Flare Blitz
description: The user sets itself on fire, recklessly charging against the target with a brutal strike.

name: Fusion Flare
description: The Pokémon sets ablaze a swirling pillar upon the target, said pillar will grow taller and swirl faster if there's a special kind of charge nearby.

name: Heat Crash
description: The user slams the target with a body engulfed in fire.

name: Overheat
description: A furious wave of scorching fire that will turn to ashes everything it touches, exhausting the user afterwards.

name: Mystical Fire
description: This mystical fire not only burns the foe, it also drains its power.

name: Mind Blown
description: The Pokémon has had a terrible day and has a very bad headache, try not to disturb its peace because its head feels like exploding.

name: Magma Storm
description: The Pokémon shoots a fiery explosion to its foe. Unable to escape and surrounded by the unbearable heat the foe's survival is at risk.

name: Lava Plume
description: The user shoots up bits of molten laval that fall scattered around the field.

name: Inferno
description: The Pokémon sets the foe on fire. These flames rise up to 6 feet. A very dangerous move.

name: Incinerate
description: The Pokémon releases a blast of fire that instantly consumes small flammable objects.

name: Heat Wave
description: The user breathes a giant wave of incandescent air that might set fire to whatever it touches.

name: Pyro Ball
description: The Pokémon lights a heavy stone on fire and kicks it while it's ablaze. The hit is pretty heavy already, the fire is just for showing off.

name: Sacred Fire
description: A blazing pillar of rainbow-colored flames crashes upon the foe, it burns and cleanses the evil from within. Those with a pure heart should not fear for they'll be unharmed.

name: Searing Shot
description: The user torches everything around itself in a sudden burst of scarlet flames. Everything is brought to cinders in a matter of seconds.

name: Shell Trap
description: It apparently just buries underground, but secretly the Pokémon prepares its shell to detonate; anyone who steps on it will be blown to pieces.

name: Sizzly Slide
description: The user slides on the floor as if it was ice-skating, only there is no ice, only a raging fire.

name: Sunny Day
description: The Pokémon will raise the temperature along with the sun, it doesn't work at night, indoors, underground or underwater.

name: V-Create
description: The user slams its foe with a V-Shaped flame on its forehead, upon impact, it detonates a terrible explosion and leaves the user pretty vulnerable afterwards.

name: Will-o-Wisp
description: The user calls a floating ember to consume the foe.

name: Aqua Jet
description: The user propels itself with a blast of water and strikes at high speed.

name: Aqua Ring
description: The user coats itself in a special flowing water that lessens the pain.

name: Aqua Tail
description: The user swings its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

name: Bouncy Bubble
description: The user shoots bubbles at its target, the bubbles fill up with fresh water upon contact and bounce back towards the user. Should you drink the water inside? Who cares? It's fun!

name: Brine
description: The user blasts the foe with extremely dense water, if the target is tired he may be swept away easily by the pressure.

name: Bubble
description: A spray of bubbles flies around the enemies, some of the bubbles stick to their bodies hindering their movement.

name: Bubble Beam
description: A long stream of bubbles hits the foe, the bubble foam may prevent the target from moving freely.

name: Clamp
description: The user traps and crushes the opponent using its thick and sturdy shell.

name: Crabhammer
description: A large pincer strikes with the power of a hammer. The demolition power is incredible.

name: Dive
description: The user submerges into the water and continues diving at an insane speed.

name: Fishious Rend
description: This Pokémon uses its gills to snap at its target, even if they don't have teeth, they can still have a crushing strength.

name: Hydro Cannon
description: The Pokémon blasts the foe with a water surge that could bring down a house. The user needs to rest afterwards.

name: Hydro Pump
description: The user builds up pressure inside its body and then releases a tremendous amount of water at the target.

name: Life Dew
description: The user creates a fresh-water dew that makes it and its allies full of energy.

name: Liquidation
description: The Pokémon gets close to its foe then strikes while bursting a full-force blast of pressurized water, the water may cut or dent through the foe's armor.

name: Muddy Water
description: The user fills its mouth with dirt and spits a torrent of mud at the foes. This mud may get in the eyes of the enemies.

name: Octazooka
description: The user sprays ink at the target's face to obstruct its vision.

name: Origin Pulse
description: The Pokémon sends a giant pulse underwater that creates a chain reaction and causes water to move in large streams. It is believed that all water in the sea moves thanks to this.

name: Rain Dance
description: The user performs a curious mystic dance that summons a heavy rainfall.

name: Razor Shell
description: The Pokémon uses its sharp shell as a weapon to cut the target's fur, armor or anything protecting its body.

name: Scald
description: The user shoots a torrent of boiling water, it may leave the foe sopping with burns.

name: Snipe Shot
description: The user shoots a piercing water jet with incredible precision.

name: Soak
description: The user shoots a stream of water and moisture that clings to the foe's body as an overcoat.

name: Sparkling Aria
description: The Pokémon sings a beautiful melody, the song comes out as a sparkling fountain, bursting upon impact and quenching any fire on its path.

name: Splishy Splash
description: The Pokémon rides a giant surge of electricity as if surfing. It looks incredibly rad but it is also dangerous, as electricity does not share the same properties of water for safe surfing.

name: Steam Eruption
description: In less than a second, the sound of steam boiling over a raging engine thunders through the ears of the foe before it is shot through the sky by a scalding geyser.

name: Surf
description: A giant wave of water sweeps the areaa while the user swims on top of it.

name: Water Gun
description: The user learns to shoot water with enough force to hurt the foe.

name: Water Pledge
description: The Pokémon chants to invoke the power of water. Moisture in the air bends the light to create an inspiring rainbow. Everyone on the field is sure to give its best.

name: Water Pulse
description: The Pokémon attacks with a pulsing blast of water, this leaves the foe feeling dizzy.

name: Water Shuriken
description: The Pokémon quickly throws sharp jets of water in the shape of a shuriken.

name: Water Sport
description: The user soaks the battlefield with moisture, making it harder for fire attacks to ignite.

name: Water Spout
description: The Pokémon builds up an amazing pressure and releases a huge columnar vortex of water that could even reach the clouds.

name: Waterfall
description: The Pokémon may swim with such strength that it may even swim upwards in a waterfall.

name: Whirlpool
description: Trap the foe inside a violent swirling whirlpool that make the foe unable to escape the battle.

name: Withdraw
description: The user hides inside its hard shell to protect itself from incoming attacks.

name: Absorb
description: The user absorbs the vital energy out of its foe.

name: Apple Acid
description: The Pokémon produces a sap from the tart apples it feeds on. This sap is acidic and bad for your teeth.

name: Aromatherapy
description: The Pokémon releases medicinal scents and vapors to refresh the user and its allies.

name: Branch Poke
description: The Pokémon rudely starts poking its foe with a stick.

name: Bullet Seed
description: The Pokémon shoots seeds rapidly as if they were bullets.

name: Cotton Guard
description: The user covers itself in cotton puffs that severely reduce the impact of physical attacks.

name: Cotton Spore
description: The Pokémon covers the foe in cotton, disrupting its movement speed.

name: Drum Beating
description: The Pokémon has a perfectly good drum and you'd think it would use it. But it doesn't. It uses its foe.

name: Energy Ball
description: The Pokémon gathers nature's energy in a ball and hurls at at the foe. Trees and bushes may be left opaque and sad.

name: Forest's Curse
description: The user calls the forest to lay a curse upon the target making it grow vines and vegetation around its whole body. The curse will not be easily lifted without a medium's help.

name: Frenzy Plant
description: User roots down and calls the plants to grow in a frenzy around the foe, though it leaves the user exhausted.

name: Giga Drain
description: The Pokémon extracts a great amount of vital energy from the foe's body.

name: Grass Knot
description: The user snares the target's feet with grass, making it fall to the ground. The bigger the foe the harder the fall.

name: Grass Pledge
description: The Pokémon chants to invoke the power of grass. Its pledge is heard, then the soil trembles and the ground crumbles as vegetation rises to grapple anyone in the field.

name: Grass Whistle
description: The user plays a beautiful and soothing melody that lulls the target into a peaceful sleep.

name: Grassy Terrain
description: The Pokémon calls upon the healing power of nature to grow a patch of miraculous grass on its side of the battlefield.

name: Grav Apple
description: The Pokémon rises on top of its foe and drops an apple on their head. The foe proceeds to eat the apple, distracting it from the fight.

name: Horn Leech
description: The user rams the foe and absorbs some of its vital energy with its horns.

name: Ingrain
description: The Pokémon roots itself to the ground, absorbing the nutrients and recovering health.

name: Leaf Blade
description: The Pokémon uses the sharp leaves on its body to cut through the foe.

name: Leaf Storm
description: A furious storm of sharp leaves swirlds and pierces the target. The user is left exhausted.

name: Leaf Tornado
description: A bush worth of sharp leaves swirls around the foe making it harder for it to aim attacks properly.

name: Leafage
description: The user throws leaf darts towards its foe.

name: Leech Seed
description: The user plants some seeds on the target, the seeds sprout and restore the user's health by abosrbing the foe's vital energy.

name: Magical Leaf
description: The user sends out a floating leaf that will pursue the target until it hits.

name: Mega Drain
description: The user absorbs a big amount of vital energy from the target.

name: Needle Arm
description: The Pokémon hits the foe with its flailing arms. Some thorns may get stuck on the target like needles.

name: Petal Blizzard
description: The Pokémon showers the battlefield with a raging blizzard of petals and leaves. Anyone close to the user will suffer the consequences.

name: Petal Dance
description: The Pokémon starts swirling petals around in a true display of nature's power. The petals are guided by the wind to strike the foe.

name: Power Whip
description: The Pokémon violently lashes the foe with its vines or a part of its body, acting as a powerful whip.

name: Razor Leaf
description: The Pokémon shoots one or more sharp leaves that cut through all targets as if they were razors.

name: Sappy Seed
description: From a magical bean the user grows a cute stalk that will attach itself to the nearest target. Once it ingrains it will grow, and grow, and grow until it reaches the sky.

name: Seed Bomb
description: The user throws a big seed that explodes on contact with the foe.

name: Seed Flare
description: The user releases an explosion of pollen and seeds that the foe cannot shake off, leaving it vulnerable. Over time, these seeds will grow into gigantic trees of life.

name: Sleep Powder
description: The user scatters powder around. Anyone who comes in contact with it will fall asleep.

name: Snap Trap
description: The user is so flat that you can barely see it in the tall grass. It is just waiting for its foe to get close enough to use its body as a snare trap.

name: Solar Beam
description: The user focuses the sunlight it has absorbed into a powerful and devastating beam of light.

name: Solar Blade
description: The Pokémon focuses the sunlight on its sharp leaves, then releases the energy with a shattering blow.

name: Spiky Shield
description: The Pokémon covers itself with a thorn filled shell. The foe will be damaged if it hits directly into it.

name: Spore
description: A powerful somniferous spore that is shot at the target to make it fall asleep.

name: Strength Sap
description: The Pokémon looks for a weak point on its foe, then feeds on its vital energy. The foe is left feeling feeble.

name: Stun Spore
description: A blow of dust that paralyzes the target on the spot and cramps its muscles.

name: Synthesis
description: The Pokémon uses the sunlight as energy to regain its vitality.

name: Trop Kick
description: The user strikes with an intense and alluring kick.

name: Vine Whip
description: The Pokémon uses its slender vines as a whip against the foe. They are as long as 20 feet.

name: Wood Hammer
description: The Pokémon recklessly slams the foe with a part of its rugged body. The user also gets hurt in the process.

name: Worry Seed
description: The user plants a seed in its foe. It causes a restless proccupation that won't let it sleep at night.

name: Aura Wheel
description: The Pokémon happily runs into a wheel made of electricity that strikes the foe. If the user is feeling hungry the wheel's energy is replaced by a dark aura.

name: Bolt Beak
description: The Pokémon charges with its beak and pecks its foe. If the foe is not fast it will be zapped by a jolt of electricity.

name: Bolt Strike
description: The user delivers a powerful tackle while discharging lightning through its body. The foe is rendered unable to move either by the strike or the electricity.

name: Electro Ball
description: The Pokémon creates a small electricity orb that is hurled at the target. If the user is faster the impact will be bigger.

name: Electrify
description: The user hurls an electric projectile at the target. The foe is charged with electricity until it is released by the foe's next attack.

name: Electric Terrain
description: The user electrifies the terrain making it impossible to get a good night's sleep on it.

name: Eerie Impulse
description: The user radiates electricity around itself. The foe will think twice about attacking.

name: Discharge
description: The user releases its stored electricity in all directions.

name: Charge Beam
description: The Pokémon lets out an electric beam, then uses the remaining charge to boost its power.

name: Charge
description: The user concentrates all of the electricity in its body to be released.

name: Buzzy Buzz
description: The Pokémon releases a jolt of static electricity from its fur that makes a cute zapping sound. It's all fun and games until somebody gets paralyzed.

name: Electroweb
description: Shoots an electrified web at all foes to restrict their movement. Walking through this web can be painful.

name: Fusion Bolt
description: The Pokémon strikes with a devastating electric impact. Said impact will grow larger and stronger if there's a special kind of fire nearby.

name: Ion Deluge
description: The user amplifies all electrically charged particles in the environment. The results are shocking!

name: Magnet Rise
description: The Pokémon uses the magnetic field of the earth to repel itself from the ground allowing it to float for a short period of time.

name: Ion Deluge
description: The user amplifies all electrically charged particles in the environment. The results are shocking!

name: Magnetic Flux
description: The Pokémon bends the magnetic field around itself. This also affects all allies who are sensitive to it.

name: Nuzzle
description: The Pokémon rubs its electrified cheeks against the foe. It looks very cute but it can be dangerous.

name: Overdrive
description: The Pokémon uses its own body as an amplifier for the energizing sounds it produces.

name: Parabolic Charge
description: The Pokémon lets loose a big eletric charge from its body. The charge comes back to it even bigger.

name: Thunder Shock
description: A small electric attack that shocks the foe and may leave it with muscular cramps. Some electric devices hit by this attack will malfunction.

name: Thunder Punch
description: An electrified punch to deal a shocking blow.

name: Thunder Fang
description: The user lands an electrified bite on the foe. The direct current may affect the foe greatly.

name: Thunder
description: The Pokémon commands a tremendous lightning bolt to strike a specific point on the ground. It's quite dangerous.

name: Spark
description: The user tackles the foe, releasing a powerful spark on contact.

name: Shock Wave
description: The user quickly releases jolts of electricity that are too fast for many to react.

name: Plasma Fists
description: The user charges its fists with electricity. Upon impact that charge materializes into plasma that adds an electric element to all of its Normal moves.

name: Pika Papow
description: The user lets out its energy in the form of a lightning strike. The happier the user feels the more energized it will be.

name: Thunder Wave
description: A tide of bright lightning streams from the floor onto the foe. The target's body will be cramped for hours.

name: Thunderbolt
description: A strong electric attack that shocks and harms the foe. It can destroy most kinds of electric equipment.

name: Volt Switch
description: The user quickly shoots an electricity jolt then switches places with an awaiting Pokémon partner at the speed of lightning.

name: Volt Tackle
description: The user surrounds itself with big bolts of electricity, then it crashes against the foe.

name: Wild Charge
description: The Pokémon surrounds itself with wild bolts of lightning then tackles recklessly.

name: Zing Zap
description: The user hurls itself as a zig-zagging ball of electricity that explodes on contact. This leaves the foe unable to move for a few seconds.

name: Zap Cannon
description: The user hurls a dreadful bombardment of electric explosions. Anyone hit won't be able to move for a very long time.

name: Zippy Zap
description: The user zips and zaps from one place to another to strike the foe moving so fast it appears to be teleporting, leaving almost no time to react.

name: Agility
description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster.

name: Ally Switch
description: The user teleports, switching its place with someone.

name: Amnesia
description: As a fine example of mind over matter, the user temporarily empties its mind to make it more resilient.

name: Barrier
description: The user casts a protective field around itself.

name: Calm Mind
description: The user quietly calms its spirit to strengthen its mind and body.

name: Confusion
description: The target's mind is hit by a weak psychic force that leaves them wondering if they were hit by an invisible enemy. Sometimes the foe is left seeing things that aren't really there.

name: Cosmic Power
description: The user absorbs power from space. This Pokémon glows faintly with energy afterwards.

name: Dream Eater
description: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. When the foe wakes up it will feel weak and empty.

name: Extrasensory
description: The user attacks with an odd, almost invisible power.

name: Future Sight
description: The Pokémon foresees something terrible happening to the target. It may see images from its own future without any risk.

name: Glitzy Glow
description: The user surrounds itself with a glamorous light, releasing it as a psychic blast. The soft glowing particles remain in the field protecting its fabulousness.

name: Gravity
description: The gravity is intensified, bringing everyone to their knees. Flying Pokémon are slammed to the ground.

name: Guard Split
description: The user employs its psychic power to average its resilience with the foe. They both feel like they're equals in terms of toughness.

name: Guard Swap
description: The Pokémon employs its psychic power to make the opponent feel like it got the user's frailty and make the user feel like it got the target's resilience.

name: Heal Block
description: The user forces everyone's wounds to stay open by using its immense psychic power.

name: Heal Pulse
description: The user emits a pulse of energy that heals the wounds of its allies.

name: Healing Wish
description: The power of ultimate love and sacrifice. The user wishes to completely heal all injuries, diseases and ailments to save someone's life at the cost of one's own health.

name: Heart Stamp
description: This move controls the emotions of the target making it feel loved and safe. The user may strike immediately.

name: Heart Swap
description: The user and the target swap their feelings of power and weakness, insecurity and courage, love and hate. Boosts are also swapped.

name: Hyperspace Hole
description: The user knows the laws of physics bind it from being in many places at once and forbit it from occupying the same space as other bodies. It just disreguards their authority.

name: Hypnosis
description: Employ a hypnotic suggestion to make the target feel drowsy and fall into a deep slumber. Works better on a target that is not in danger.

name: Imprison
description: This move blocks specific parts of the memory the user is well aware of. Be it moves, techniques, names, places, people or situations. The target won't be able to recall those memories.

name: Instruct
description: The Pokémon sends a psychic command to one of its allies or foes to enable them to repeat their last action.

name: Kinesis
description: A basic psychic power to exert force on objects. You can touch, move, press and affect simple objects to create distractions.

name: Light Screen
description: The user manifests its mental power on the world, creating walls and floors of light that help prevent the passing of energies.

name: Lunar Dance
description: The moon shines at the darkest hours, reflecting the sun's lifebringing light on those who fell into the night, taking pity on their lost souls.

name: Luster Purge
description: The user engulfs itself in a blinding light and shoots a beam at its foe. This light leaves the foe powerless to resist against anyone.

name: Magic Coat
description: The user quickly creates a barrier that reflects any minor attack, status condition, or dirty trick the foe might have wanted to use.

name: Magic Powder
description: The Pokémon recites an enchantment and blows a cloud of pink dust on its target. Afterward, the target becomes especially good at guessing which card you got from a deck.

name: Magic Room
description: Inside the effects of Magic Room technology and manually activated tools and items do not work. Automated technology will function as normal.

name: Meditate
description: The Pokémon meditates to unleash a power that's been sleeping deep inside the user.

name: Miracle Eye
description: The user's sight transcends the flesh and can look directly into the innermost mental presence of everyone around. Hidden enemies can be detected.

name: Mirror Coat
description: The user canalizes the damage received by energies and bounce them back to their source.

name: Mist Ball
description: The user engulds its foe with a cloud of mist. This soothing mist keeps evil intents from surfacing into the foe's mind.

name: Photon Geyser
description: The Pokémon attacks with a large pillar of light that comes out from where its foe is standing. Either the blazing energy or the crushing strike are enough to knock someone out.

name: Power Split
description: The user employs its psychic power to average its capabilities with the foe. They both feel like they're equals in terms of strength.

name: Power Swap
description: The Pokémon employs its psychic power to make the opponent feel like it got the user's weaknesses and make the user feel like it got the target's strengths.

name: Power Trick
description: The user's mind is tricked into thinking that strength comes from their vitality and their vitality is their power.

name: Prismatic Laser
description: Through a prism the user shoots a concentrated laser beam that pierces everything that comes in contact with it. The effort leaves the user mentally exhausted.

name: Psybeam
description: Attack with a beam of psychic energy that hits the mind of the target.

name: Psychic
description: The user's telekinetic force is enough to cause severe harm to their target. This telekinesis is not subtle.

name: Psychic Fangs
description: The Pokémon bares its fangs to bite the foe. Psychic energy begins piercing before the actual fangs make contact.

name: Psychic Terrain
description: The arena becomes radiated by psychic waves. Everyone begins to think slowly due to the buzz in their heads making all tasks take more time.

name: Psycho Boost
description: The Pokémon releases an explosion of all of its concentrated psychic power in a devastating explosion. Afterwards the user will be extremely tired.

name: Psycho Cut
description: Create blades of psychic energy to tear down foes.

name: Psycho Shift
description: With psychic suggestion the target feels afflicted by the same status problems as the user.

name: Psyshock
description: Materialize a psychic wave that pushes the target with real physical force.

name: Psystrike
description: Through sheer psychic power the user materializes its energy to deal a heavy strike to its foe.

name: Psywave
description: Releases the inner power of the mind to emanate psychic waves that hurt the target.

name: Reflect
description: The user manifests its mental power on the world creating invisible walls and floors that prevent the passing of objects.

name: Rest
description: The user falls asleep. During this period the body benefits from a super accelerated healing process.

name: Role Play
description: The user mimics the target and takes on the most basic features from that character.

name: Skill Swap
description: The user swaps its identity with the target making both feel like they are from each other's species.

name: Speed Swap
description: The Pokémon employs its psychic power to make the opponent perceive events as if they were happening faster or slower according to the user's own speed.

name: Stored Power
description: This move allows the user to release its power. If the user has any boosts the damage is increased.

name: Synchronoise
description: The user vibrates with any particular energy Type he chooses. All nearby creatures and objects of that Type are hurt.

name: Telekinesis
description: The user can manipulate objects and creatures with his mind. Pokémon and humans become easier to hit because their movements are restrained.

name: Teleport
description: Teleport the user and one more creature to a place of tranquility and high psychic resonance such as Pokémon Centers. Ceilings and walls block this move from working.

name: Trick
description: Control the target's mind to perform a simple non-hostile action such as walking or handing an item.

name: Trick Room
