description: This reality altering move can manipulate time so slow creatures are fast and fast creatures are slow.

name: Wonder Room
description: Inside the Wonder Room a strong mind makes a strong body and a resilient body makes a resilient mind. However, if the mind is weak, the body will be weak and vice versa.

name: Zen Headbutt
description: The user focuses its will on its head to strike with a headbutt.

name: Aurora Beam
description: The Pokémon shoots a beautiful rainbow colored beam that may leave the foe flabbergasted.

name: Aurora Veil
description: Aurora lights and hail spin around the Pokémon and its allies deflecting attacks.

name: Avalanche
description: The user builds up a lot of snow around itself. If anything disturbs the snow it will fall on the attacker like an avalanche.

name: Blizzard
description: The user swirles a violent gelid wind around the foes. This blizzard may not last long, but it's tremendously strong.

name: Freeze Dry
description: The user freezes all moisture in the environment. Water type Pokémon suffer greatly.

name: Freeze Shock
description: The user appears to become a block of ice, then it releases itself from the ice with a devastating discharge. The exploding ice shards and the lightning fly all over the battlefield.

name: Freezy Frost
description: The user touches its foe while playing "Freeze!", surprisingly, the foe becomes frozen on a block of ice. Once they realize they were just playing pretend the ice dissolves into haze.

name: Frost Breath
description: The user shoots a gelid breath against the target that sends a chill through the spine. The sudden change of temperature can bring anyone to its knees.

name: Glaciate
description: The air is so cold it hurts to move, to see, to breath. Escaping should be your top priority for every second you don't your life will be at peril.

name: Hail
description: The user summons a hailstorm that will stay on the battlefield for some time.

name: Haze
description: The user sends out a haze that disturbs all the Pokémon engaged in battle. It may conceal whoever is inside.

name: Ice Ball
description: The user curls into a snowball, rolling against the foe. The ball grows bigger as it rolls.

name: Ice Beam
description: The user shoots a freezing ray that greatly lowers the temperature of anything it hits.

name: Ice Burn
description: The user appears to become a block of ice, then it releases itself from the ice with a devastating explosion. The exploding ice shards and fire blow all over the battlefield.

name: Ice Fang
description: The user bites the foe and releases a gelid breath through its mouth.

name: Ice Hammer
description: The Pokémon uses its powerful gelid arms and strikes the foe with a swing motion.

name: Ice Punch
description: The Pokémon delivers a strike covered in ice. The user's hands can freeze anything they touch.

name: Ice Shard
description: The user quickly freezes some bits of ice and throws them at the target.

name: Icicle Crash
description: The user drops a big icicle over the foe. The impact may leave the opponent dazed.

name: Icicle Spear
description: The user launches a wave of small but pointy icicles towards the target.

name: Icy Wind
description: A breeze so cold that it chills you to the bone making it harder to move.

name: Mist
description: The user cloaks itself and its allies within a cold mist with mystic properties. It may conceal whoever is nearby.

name: Powder Snow
description: The user sends out a wind current full of snowflakes that freeze whatever they touch. This powder can easily turn into a room to ice.

name: Sheer Cold
description: The user freezes the foe from the inside out. Victims of this attack will need urgent medical attention.

name: Breaking Swipe
description: The Pokémon will use its tail to make a long swipe at its foes. A few cracks are heard and the foes will limp afterwards.

name: Clanging Scales
description: The Pokémon rattles the scales of its armor creating a frightening noise in the area. Some of its scales fall off as a result leaving some areas exposed.

name: Clangerous Soul
description: The Pokémon shakes its scales around to sharpen, shed and rearrange them. It's a bit rough but in the end the Pokémon feels more focused for battle.

name: Core Enforcer
description: The user shoots a beam that fractures the target to its core rendering it unable to sustain even the most basic of its traits.

name: Draco Meteor
description: The Pokémon calls a comet that falls from the sky to deal a brutal amount of damage. This feat demands a lot from the user.

name: Dragon Rush
description: The user charges rapidly against the foe. The strike may leave the target gasping for air.

name: Dragon Rage
description: A dual colored flame that always leaves the same burn marks on everything it touches.

name: Dragon Pulse
description: The user opens its mouth and sends a powerful wave of energy.

name: Dragon Hammer
description: The Pokémon swings its body as a hammer and leaves the foe nailed to the cracked ground.

name: Dragon Darts
description: The Pokémon's head is a nest for its less evolved forms. The younglings will sometimes be used as projectiles.

name: Dragon Dance
description: The user performs a vigorous and mystical dance that boosts the fighting spirit and reflexes.

name: Dragon Claw
description: The Pokémon uses its strong claws to deliver a fierce tearing blow.

name: Dragon Breath
description: The user lets out a mystical green breath that hinders the movement of anyone it touches.

name: Dragon Tail
description: This powerful tail strike can knock back anyone up to 100 feet away!

name: Dual Chop
description: The Pokémon strikes the foe with two brutal blows.

name: Dynamax Cannon
description: The Pokémon shoots a heavy projectile. If the foe is under the effects of the Dynamax phenomenon all the energy will be concentrated and explode on the target.

name: Eternabeam
description: The Pokémon shoots an incredibly powerful beam towards the sky. The energy released might keep traveling through space thousands of years later.

name: Outrage
description: The user awakens their primal instinct as a dragon and unleashes its uncontrollable fury destroying everything in its path. After that, the Pokémon is left disoriented and confused.

name: Roar of Time
description: Through a terrifying roar the user bounds the forces of time on a single area. The unfortunate target will be trapped in a time warp, growing old in a matter of seconds.

name: Spacial Rend
description: With a flicker of its claws, the user defragments the space around its foe. Those who survive rarely do preserve their original shape.

name: Twister
description: The Pokémon lets out a spiral current that surrounds the foes. They can't move until they free themselves from this terrible whirlwind.

name: Assurance
description: The user retaliates against the foe. The rush of adrenaline allows it to hit harder.

name: Baddy Bad
description: The Pokémon acts like a thug and channels its own dark aura as protection for itself and its allies.

name: Beat Up
description: The user calls other Pokémon to aid it in battle. Together they give a beating to the foe.

name: Bite
description: The user lands a vicious bite that may leave an ugly bruise.

name: Brutal Swing
description: The Pokémon starts attacking at full force with its claws. Anyone unfortunate enough to be in its path will end up severely wounded.

name: Crunch
description: The Pokémon uses its fangs to viciously tear whatever it is biting.

name: Dark Pulse
description: The Pokémon sends a wave of dark feelings that affect those who are most vulnerable, hurting the foe and leaving it unable to act.

name: Dark Void
description: A portal opens and transports all foes to a world of darkness. Inside they can't see or feel anything, it's like they are trapped in an eternal slumber.

name: Foul Play
description: The user feints attacks then tricks the foe who ends up hurting itself.

name: Fling
description: The user takes its held item and throws it at the opponent. You may get it back after the fight.

name: Flatter
description: The user starts flattering and admiring its opponent. It sure makes it feel good about itself, but why?

name: Feint Attack
description: The Pokémon approaches the foe disarmingly then attacks suddenly without giving any time to react.

name: False Surrender
description: The Pokémon bows in defeat, begging for forgiveness, then backstabs its gullible foe.

name: Fake Tears
description: The user stops battling and feigns to be crying, disrupting the foe's mood to battle and making it lower its guard.

name: Embargo
description: The user quickly takes out the held item of a Pokémon. It also empties the bag of the trainer and forces everyone to stay away from their own properties. Evil doers master this move.

name: Darkest Lariat
description: The user swings both of its arms against the target. There's no armor thick enough to stop the strike.

name: Hone Claws
description: The Pokémon sharpens its claws to perform more precise attacks.

name: Hyperspace Fury
description: The Pokémon opens portals to attack with each one of its arms bypassing all defenses and making it impossible to escape. However, the user's defense also gets neglected.

name: Jaw Lock
description: The user will capture its foe in a crushing jaw grip. It won't let go no matter how much you try to separate them. The only way it will release its victim is by fainting.

name: Knock Off
description: The Pokémon makes a quick tackle that knocks off anything the foe was holding.

name: Memento
description: The user unleashes all its remaining power to send a wave of hopeless thoughts to haunt the foe's mind and soul. The target will be left in grief.

name: Nasty Plot
description: The Pokémon starts plotting on how to defeat the enemy. Its evil laugh reveals the bad intentions.

name: Night Daze
description: The user forms a pitch black wave that hurts the foe. This darkness may remain, obstructing the target's vision.

name: Night Slash
description: The user quickly slashes through the target as soon as it gets the chance. The intent to end the target's life is frightening.

name: Snarl
description: The Pokémon viciously snarls showing its teeth. Its menacing look will make the foe cower in fear.

name: Quash
description: The user represses the foe with intimidation so it has to think twice before acting.

name: Pursuit
description: The Pokémon chases the foe to deliver a final blow before it escapes.

name: Punishment
description: User takes advantage of its foe's strength to use them against it.

name: Power Trip
description: In the heat of the battle the Pokémon gets carried away, relishing in its own power.

name: Payback
description: The Pokémon tackles the target with hatred and vengeance.

name: Parting Shot
description: The user threatens the foe leaving it too scared to pursue the user or overwhelm the ally that just switched into the battlefield.

name: Obstruct
description: In a reckless action, the user charges against the foe to stop its momentum and block its incoming attack. Being so close allows the user to reach for weak spots.

name: Snatch
description: The user analyzes the advantages of the foe then makes them their own.

name: Sucker Punch
description: While the foe is preparing its attack the user takes advantage and strikes.

name: Switcheroo
description: The user quickly switches the held items before the foe can realize what happened.

name: Taunt
description: The user mocks and teases the target to make it attack in a raging fury.

name: Thief
description: The Pokémon strikes its foe and takes the opportunity to steal whatever the target was holding.

name: Throat Chop
description: A heinous attack to a Pokémon's throat that will leave them unable to make a sound for hours.

name: Topsy Turvy
description: The user changes the nature of its target, bad things become good and good things become bad.

name: Torment
description: The user torments and enrages the foe making it unable to keep using its strategy.

name: Light of Ruin
description: By drawing energy from the Eternal Flower the Pokémon unleashes all of its hurt. A beautiful light surrounds the area, yet the pain inside of its heart remains.

name: Geomancy
description: Through a mystical connection this Pokémon absorbs the life force of the earth itself to increase its power.

name: Flower Shield
description: The Pokémon uses a mysterious power that causes flowers to bloom beneath every Grass Pokémon nearby. Flora in this field is more resilient and beautiful.

name: Floral Healing
description: The user creates a flower crown that heals and relaxes its wearer. Under the right conditions this move also creates a flower patch around its target.

name: Fleur Cannon
description: A light beam pierces the battlefield. It deals devastating damage but leaves newly grown flowers instead of scorched earth. The user is left feeling very tired.

name: Fairy Wind
description: The Pokémon strikes with a wind covered in fairy dust. It causes itching.

name: Fairy Lock
description: The user moves as if locking a door. It takes a few moments before everyone realizes they are not really trapped.

name: Draining Kiss
description: The user sends a kiss with a flirty intention. The foe catches the kiss but it ends up draining the target's energy.

name: Aromatic Mist
description: The Pokémon showers an ally in a mist with a revitalizing aroma.

name: Baby-Doll Eyes
description: Before anyone acts in battle, the user looks at the foe with the cutest eyes.

name: Charm
description: The Pokémon uses a cute and harmless attitude to make the foe less wary and aggressive.

name: Crafty Shield
description: The Pokémon creates a magic shield to protect everyone from the bad tricks a foe might have under its sleeve. Under this shield everyone can see dishonesty and bad intentions.

name: Dazzling Gleam
description: The user shines like a powerful flash that hurts the eyes of everyone watching it.

name: Decorate
description: Using some frosting the Pokémon decorates their target to look bigger, more powerful and incredibly delicious!

name: Disarming Voice
description: With a charming and manipulative cry, the user deals emotional damage to its opponent. This move always makes the targets feel bad.

name: Sweet Kiss
description: The Pokémon moves towards the foe and plants a delicate kiss on the cheek, then leaves playfully. The foe struggles to know what it meant.

name: Strange Steam
description: The user releases an addictive sweet-smelling steam. Do not be fooled as it is toxic and has nasty side-effects.

name: Spirit Break
description: Sometimes words hurt a lot more than blows. With this move the Pokémon deals both.

name: Sparkly Swirl
description: The Pokémon unleashes a swirling and glittery energy that releases a pleasant aroma that soothes the body and has healing properties.

name: Play Rough
description: The user and the foe start a playful wrestle. It soon escalates into something not so pretty.

name: Nature's Madness
description: The forces of nature attack as if they had a will of their own. Water will try to drown you, plants will trap you, lightning will come out of nowhere and even your own body will fail you.

name: Moonlight
description: The user gathers power from the light of the moon. The energy absorbed can heal most injuries.

name: Moonblast
description: Summon power directly from the moon. The Pokémon blasts the foe with light.

name: Misty Terrain
description: The user surrounds the battlefield with a mystical mist that feels protective. Mythical Pokémon find something eerie about it.
